outline: 教導學生自然纖維，再生纖維，半合成纖，一般合成纖維,如聚酯,尼龍,亞克力,等 及特殊合成纖維，其製備,抽絲,結構,化性,物性,用途等
schedule:
1. Cotton(2 weeks)
2. Jute(1/2 week)
3. Wool(2 weeks)
4. Silk(1 week)
5. Acetate Fiber(1/2 week)
6. Rayon(1 week)
Mid-term Exam(1 week)
7. PET, PBT(2 weeks)
8. Nylons(1 week)
9. PAN, Carbon Fiber(2 weeks)
10. Polyolefin Fibers(1 week)
11.PVA Fiber(1/2 week)
12. Elastomeric Fibers(1/2 week)
13. Aramide Fibers(1 week)
14. PBI, LC Fibers, Polyimde Fibers, PPS(1 week)
15. Glass Fibers, Ceramic Fibers, Optical Fibers(If Time Available)
Final Exam(1 week)
assessment:
Term Performance Including Attendance(30%)
Mid-term Exam(30%)
Final Exam(40%)
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

Handbook of Fiber Chemistry(M.Lewin ed. 3rd ed. CRC, 2006)
